title: Canonical Weil cohomology commutes with immersion inverse image
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum, l a prime distinct from its characteristic, and Qbar an algebraic closure of the l-adic field, in a universe independent of that of D. For every locally closed immersion h0 of separated finite-type finite-field schemes, every common-stage Weil complex K and every integer a, H^a of the canonical Weil pullback of K is isomorphic in the constructible Weil heart to the canonical pullback of H^a(K). Here H^a is sfWeilCohomology and the inverse-image Weil square is precisely zlFrobeniusSquare; no alternate shift or Frobenius structure is chosen. Uses [def-weil-constructible-heart; def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-weil-complex-weights; def-weil-closed-immersion; def-weil-open-immersion; def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom; sk-d-dl-general-weights; def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category].

proof.text: The actual underlying inverse image is t-exact. Use upper and lower truncation comparisons characterized by their counit and unit equations, then the signed representative-normalized pullback shift.

proof.text: The two composition comparisons making zlFrobeniusSquare commute with those normalized shifts: verify on signed integral representatives and descend through rational and common-stage coefficient passage. Truncation comparison naturality and composition then make the cohomology comparison Frobenius equivariant.

proof.text: The underlying canonical cohomology isomorphism thus lifts to fixed pairs and then to the full constructible hearts. Its inverse gives the displayed direction. The construction works for identity, empty schemes, arbitrary degree and both independent universes.

lean.statement:
theorem zlCanonicalImmersionCohomology (h₀ : W₀ ⟶ X₀) [IsImmersion h₀.left] :
    ∀ (a : ℤ) (K : sfCommonStageWeilComplex D l hl X₀ Qbar),
      Nonempty
        (((sfWeilCohomology D l hl Qbar W₀ a).obj
          ((IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso (zlFrobeniusSquare D l hl Qbar h₀)).obj K)) ≅
          (zlWeilPull D l hl Qbar h₀).obj ((sfWeilCohomology D l hl Qbar X₀ a).obj K))
